units.source_text: 《唐守》与《藐姑射老妪》皆古代小说，今已不传。

en.t: Tangshou and The Old Woman of Miaogushe are both ancient tales that are no longer extant today.

units.source_text: 赫映姬是《竹取物语》中的女主角的名字。

en.t: Kaguya-hime is the name of the heroine in The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter.

units.source_text: 《竹取物语》是日本最古的故事小说，作于平安朝初期（九世纪）。

en.t: The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter is Japan's oldest narrative tale, composed in the early Heian period, in the ninth century.

units.source_text: 大意：竹取老翁劈竹，发现竹筒中有一三寸长美女，不久长大，取名赫映姬。

en.t: In outline: an old bamboo cutter split open a stalk of bamboo and found inside it a beautiful girl three inches tall; before long she grew up and was named Kaguya-hime.

units.source_text: 阿部御主人、车持皇子等五人向她求婚，她都出难题拒绝。

en.t: Five men, including Abe no Miushi and Prince Kuramochi, proposed to her, but she rejected them all by setting impossible tasks.
The emperor also wanted to marry her, but she would not consent.

units.source_text: 终于八月十五之夜升入月宫。

en.t: In the end, on the night of the fifteenth day of the eighth month, she ascended to the palace of the moon.
